bead.title: Wire object-log S3 runtime env parsing and readiness validation
bead.description:
PROBLEM: The service accepts `object_log_sqlite_projection`, but the container runtime does not parse S3-compatible object-log configuration, SQLite projection storage settings, or validate live object-store connectivity before reporting readiness.

ROOT CAUSE: `crates/pqueue-service/src/runtime.rs:93` through `crates/pqueue-service/src/runtime.rs:106` define runtime config with only `postgres_database_url`; `crates/pqueue-service/src/runtime.rs:146` only reads `PQUEUE_POSTGRES_DATABASE_URL`; `crates/pqueue-service/src/runtime.rs:167` through `crates/pqueue-service/src/runtime.rs:175` returns `ReadinessCheck::Ready` for `ObjectLogSqliteProjection` without checking S3-compatible object storage, SQLite projection path, segment settings, credentials, or Postgres control-plane configuration.

PROPOSED FIX: Extend `RuntimeConfig` and runtime tests to parse and validate the object-log environment contract: `PQUEUE_OBJECT_LOG_ENDPOINT`, `PQUEUE_OBJECT_LOG_BUCKET`, `PQUEUE_OBJECT_LOG_REGION`, `PQUEUE_OBJECT_LOG_ACCESS_KEY_ID`, `PQUEUE_OBJECT_LOG_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY`, `PQUEUE_OBJECT_LOG_SEGMENT_MAX_COMMANDS`, `PQUEUE_SQLITE_PROJECTION_DIR`, and required Postgres control-plane URL. Add a readiness path that instantiates or probes the configured object-log path and verifies the SQLite projection directory is usable before returning ready.

GOVERNING ARTIFACTS: Parent bead `pqueue-3546063c`; `docs/helix/02-design/technical-designs/TD-004-s3-object-log-sqlite-projection-mode.md`; `docs/helix/04-build/DEPLOYMENT-READINESS.md`; `docs/deployment/container-runtime-contract.md`.

NON-SCOPE: Cloud-provider-specific IAM/TLS hardening beyond an S3-compatible MinIO proof. Replacing the existing fjord object-log abstraction or queue semantics. Helm rendering, kind orchestration, and prose documentation changes are handled by sibling beads.
bead.acceptance:
1. TestObjectLogRuntimeEnvValidation: `cargo test -p pqueue-service --test container_runtime_contract_tests -- --nocapture` passes and covers required env/config validation for `object_log_sqlite_projection`, including endpoint, bucket, region, credentials, segment max commands, SQLite projection directory, and Postgres control-plane URL.
2. TestObjectLogReadinessRequiresConfiguredDependencies: `cargo test -p pqueue-service --test container_runtime_contract_tests -- --nocapture` passes and proves `/readyz` returns unavailable when required object-log or SQLite projection configuration is missing or unusable.
3. TestObjectLogReadinessProbesConfiguredPath: `cargo test -p pqueue-service --test container_runtime_contract_tests -- --nocapture` passes and proves readiness validates the configured S3-compatible object-log path instead of returning unconditional ready.
4. TestQualityGates: `go test ./...` and `lefthook run pre-commit` pass from the repository root, alongside the Rust command in AC1.
